reviews.title: Scam alert
reviews.text: Insanely overpriced and barely functional. You have been warned.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work mostly
reviews.text: Trying live voice translate and most of the time I hit the button and it listens for about half a second then stops and says ‘Sorry I’m not sure what you said’. Can’t get it to translate more than one or two words at a time .

reviews.title: It don’t work
reviews.text: Keeps asking for microphone access, but doesn’t let you allow the access…the app don’t work.
